acquisition method: The tryptic peptides were analyzed directly using DIA MS and fractionated using strong anion exchange (SAX) followed by DDA MS analysis
alkylation reagent: Filters with immobilized proteins were then incubated with 8 M urea buffer containing 50 mM iodoacetamide for 30 min in the dark.
collision energy: fragmented by higher energy induced collision dissociation (HCD, collision energy: 30)
fragmentation method: fragmented by higher energy induced collision dissociation (HCD, collision energy: 30)
instrument: Global proteome DDA MS analysis was performed on a Q-Exactive Plus (Thermo Fisher) mass spectrometer... For DIA MS analysis (sample sets 1 and 2), a Q-Exactive HF-X (Thermo Fisher) mass spectrometer was employed.
labeling: Label-free quantification (LFQ) and match between run options were enabled.
reduction reagent: precipitated protein pellets were then resuspended 100 mM Tris (pH 8.0) buffer containing 100 mM dithiothreitol
